title: Russian cargo ship Sparta II evacuated after drone strike in Gulf of Finland
seoTitle: Russian cargo ship Sparta II hit by drone in Baltic Sea
dek: A Russian cargo vessel caught fire following a drone strike in the Gulf of Finland. The crew was evacuated to a Russian ship, and Finnish authorities have implemented temporary maritime and aviation restrictions in the area.
happened: On 21 November, the Russian cargo ship Sparta II was struck by drones while traveling toward the Russian exclave of Kaliningrad. According to Finnish defence forces, the strike occurred in international waters west of the island of Suursaari, also known as Gogland. The vessel caught fire and subsequently drifted into Finnish waters. Finnish border officials were alerted to the incident at approximately 08:50 local time. The 16-member crew initially remained on board but was later evacuated to a Russian vessel, which departed for Russia. Finnish authorities, supported by an Estonian navy vessel, led the rescue and monitoring operation. During the response, Finnish officials reported a suspected violation of Finnish airspace by a Russian helicopter. Finland has established temporary aviation and maritime restrictions in the eastern Gulf of Finland. Finnish defence forces stated that Ukraine was likely responsible for the attack, though Kyiv has not provided a comment. The Sparta II is linked to the Russian company Oboronlogistika and is subject to international sanctions.

sides.says: Prime Minister Petteri Orpo stated, "War is spilling over into our immediate vicinity," and affirmed that "Ukraine has the right to fight back against the aggressor." Defence officials confirmed the ship drifted into Finnish waters and that an investigation is underway.

Alexei Besprozvannykh reported that two drones were involved in the attack and stated there was "no threat" to the exclave's supplies. He noted that the crew had been carrying out necessary work on the vessel.
Spokesperson Aki-Mauri Huhtinen stated, "It is likely that Ukraine … is behind (the attack)," while noting it remained unclear why the specific vessel was targeted.

next: Finnish authorities are conducting an investigation into the drone strike and coordinating with relevant international partners, including NATO.
summary: A Russian cargo ship, the Sparta II, was damaged by a drone strike in the Gulf of Finland on 21 November. The vessel caught fire and drifted into Finnish waters, prompting a rescue operation and the evacuation of its 16-member crew to a Russian ship. Finnish officials, who identified the incident as a likely Ukrainian attack, have imposed temporary restrictions in the area. The ship is linked to the Russian military and is under international sanctions. The incident has raised concerns regarding the expansion of the Russia-Ukraine war into the Baltic region.
